### The Lord Saves His Servants
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-saves-his-servants
Passage: Jeremiah 39:1-18
Points:
- Jerusalem's fall to the Babylonian army brought about the prophesied judgment on Judah for persistent unfaithfulness.
- While Zedekiah and his nobles faced severe consequences, God did not forget His faithful servants during the devastation.
- The Lord moved the pagan king Nebuchadnezzar to protect Jeremiah and ensure his safety and freedom among his people.
- God also extended mercy and preserved the life of Ebed-melech the Ethiopian because he had trusted in the Lord.
- The Lord shows no partiality and unfailingly rewards and delivers all who put their confidence in Him.
